finishes.notes: Calm, warm, Scandinavian-leaning interior: natural oak and walnut, boucle and linen, cream, sand and terracotta accents, soft daylight.

cameras.name: From the window, looking to the kitchen

assets.name: Albie Travertine Round Coffee Table 90
assets.description: Round coffee table with a honed beige travertine top cradled by four chunky cylindrical legs in blond-oak finish solid wood. Earthy and organic.

assets.name: Anya Dining Chair, Chestnut
assets.description: Chunky, stackable-look dining chair in chestnut-stained solid ash, with square legs, a flat wooden seat and a curved rounded-rectangle backrest panel.

assets.name: Arlo Armchair
assets.description: Sculptural lounge chair: two chunky round-section solid-rubberwood U-frames in chestnut stain with smoothly bent corners (front leg into armrest, armrest curving up into a taller back post) joined by a low rear stretcher, holding a flat-topped seat cushion with a rounded front edge and a slightly reclined rounded-rectangle back pad, both in flecked sand/oatmeal textured boucle-like fabric.

assets.name: Ashen Wood Sideboard 180cm
assets.description: Light natural ash-veneer sideboard with four panelled doors divided by slim reeded vertical battens, rounded corner posts and short curved solid-ash legs. Calm and Japandi-leaning.

assets.name: Auburn 3 Seater Sofa
assets.description: Low, structured modern 3-seater sofa in chalk-white boucle: two large flat-topped seat blocks with vertical sides and softly rounded edges, one continuous low back with a shallow centre seam that wraps round into a rolled arm at each end, the arms set back from the seat front and overhanging a recessed dark plinth on hidden glides, two square boucle scatter cushions.

assets.name: Auburn Chaise Sofa (left-facing)

parts.name: back wrap round the chaise's rear corner

assets.description: Low, structured modern chaise sofa in chalk-white boucle, chaise on the left: one long flat-topped chaise block and two flat-topped seat blocks with vertical sides and softly rounded edges, one continuous low back in three shallow sections that rolls down round the chaise's rear corner and wraps into a single rolled arm at the right end, the arm set back from the seat front and overhanging a recessed dark plinth on hidden glides, two square boucle scatter cushions.

assets.name: Auburn Chaise Sofa (right-facing)

parts.name: back wrap round the chaise's rear corner

assets.description: Low, structured modern chaise sofa in chalk-white boucle, chaise on the right: one long flat-topped chaise block and two flat-topped seat blocks with vertical sides and softly rounded edges, one continuous low back in three shallow sections that rolls down round the chaise's rear corner and wraps into a single rolled arm at the left end, the arm set back from the seat front and overhanging a recessed dark plinth on hidden glides, two square boucle scatter cushions.

assets.name: Auburn Footstool
assets.description: Low, structured footstool in chalk-white boucle matching the Auburn sofas: one flat-topped upholstered block with vertical sides, softly rounded corners and a modest rounded edge, on a recessed dark plinth with hidden glides; it can butt up to the front of an Auburn seat.

assets.name: Austen Chair, Walnut Stain
assets.description: Mid-century dining chair in walnut-stained rubberwood with a curved bentwood back rail and a hand-woven natural paper-cord seat. Inspired by Danish design.

assets.name: Avery Swivel Armchair
assets.description: Round barrel swivel armchair upholstered all over in ginger/terracotta boucle: a round seat drum with a softly rounded top edge, wrapped by a curved wall with a rolled top edge that is highest at the back and slopes gently down to rounded arm fronts, a rectangular lumbar pillow against the back, on a low recessed round swivel base.

assets.name: Blair Large Pendant 61cm
assets.description: Large tiered drum pendant handmade from natural jute and paper raffia in warm straw tones: three stacked open-weave bands with a solid woven middle drum, on a black cord and canopy. Modelled as hung over a dining table: cord shortened so the shade bottom is ~750mm above a 760mm table (~1510mm off the floor under a 2450mm ceiling); 940mm drop = ~450mm shade + ~490mm cord and canopy (listing max drop 2293mm incl. 1830mm cord).

assets.name: Cora Wool Rug 229x274 (caramel)
assets.description: Soft, loom-knotted wool-blend rug in warm caramel/toffee with a subtle tonal striation and a dense nubby knot pile.

assets.name: Faro Round Wall Mirror 75cm
assets.description: Round wall mirror with a thick, bobbled bead-like frame in raw off-white resin. Playful and sculptural, a soft counterpoint to all the wood.

assets.name: Faro Sculptural Floor Lamp

parts.name: stacked bead-and-bicone column on drum base

assets.description: Sculptural floor lamp with a stacked bead-and-bicone column in sand-textured off-white resin, on a drum base, topped with a cream fabric coolie (tapered) shade.

assets.name: Faro Table Lamp 53cm
assets.description: Sculptural table lamp with a sand-textured off-white resin base of stacked bicones on a dome foot, under a cream fabric coolie shade. It matches the Faro floor lamp.

assets.name: Harper Sideboard, Chestnut / Brass
assets.description: Curvy pill-shaped sideboard in chestnut-stained oak veneer, with sliding tambour slat doors, a central pair of long brass bar handles and slim brass legs. It matches the Harper table and TV stand.

assets.name: Harper Dining Table 180cm, Chestnut
assets.description: Racetrack (stadium-shaped) dining table in chestnut-stained oak veneer on a single elongated pedestal wrapped in vertical tambour slats. Warm mid-brown oak with soft curved ends and a mid-century feel.

assets.name: Harper Dining Table 220cm, Chestnut
assets.description: Long racetrack (stadium-shaped) dining table in chestnut-stained oak veneer, its smooth top resting on two drum pedestals clad in vertical tambour slats. Warm mid-brown oak with soft curved ends and a mid-century feel.

assets.name: Harper Marble Rectangular Coffee Table
assets.description: Racetrack coffee table with a white Carrara marble top with soft grey veining, set on two drum pedestals clad in chestnut-stained oak tambour slats. It matches the Harper dining table.

assets.name: Harper Marble Side Table
assets.description: Drum side table: a cylinder of chestnut-stained oak tambour slats capped with a white Carrara marble disc top.

assets.name: Harper Round Dining Table 120cm, Chestnut
assets.description: Round dining table in chestnut-stained oak veneer on a single drum pedestal clad in vertical tambour slats. It is the compact round version of the Harper table.

assets.name: Harper Small Sideboard with Small Shelving Unit, Chestnut
assets.description: Two-piece Harper storage wall in chestnut oak: a pill-shaped tambour-door sideboard on brass legs, topped by an open shelving unit with rounded, cantilevered shelves. Good for books, plants and dining ware.

assets.name: Harper TV Stand 150
assets.description: Pill-shaped media console in chestnut-stained oak veneer, with curved tambour (vertical slat) sliding doors, slim brass bar handles and slender brass legs. It matches the Harper dining table and sideboard.

assets.name: Inez Wool Rug 153x244 (beige)
assets.description: Chunky hand-woven 100% New Zealand wool rug in ivory/beige with a bobbly, knitted loop texture. Soft and cosy underfoot.

assets.name: Jana Jute Rug 229x274
assets.description: Flat-woven 100% jute rug in natural straw-gold, with a chunky handwoven texture. Earthy and hard-wearing, good under a dining table.

assets.name: Madison 2 Seater Sofa
assets.description: Compact mid-century loveseat in pale oatmeal "bisque" woven fabric, with a single biscuit-tufted bench seat, two loose back cushions and round bolsters. It stands on tapered walnut-stained legs.

assets.name: Mori C-Side Table
assets.description: Compact C-shaped side table in natural brushed oak veneer that slides under a sofa arm or seat. Simple flat planes with lap-joint details.

assets.name: Mori Coffee Table
assets.description: Low, minimalist slab coffee table in natural brushed oak veneer. A thick rectangular top sits on two slab legs, with lap-joint details showing through the top.

assets.name: Nico Console Table 120cm
assets.description: Slim console table in solid American oak with a dark chestnut lacquer. It has a rounded "pebble" top and three chunky slab legs placed at irregular, sculptural positions.

assets.name: Nico Dining Bench 150cm
assets.description: Backless dining bench in solid American oak with a dark chestnut lacquer. It has a pebble-shaped top with rounded corners and chunky slab legs.

assets.name: Nico TV Stand 150
assets.description: Solid American oak media console in a rich reddish-brown finish, with softly rounded "pebble" corners, two flush doors, a central open niche over a drawer, and two slab sled legs.

assets.name: Owen II 3 Seater Sofa
assets.description: Tailored 3-seater with thin square track arms in nubby cream basketweave: two loose seat cushions and two tall loose back cushions with neat welted edges and softly rounded corners, two rectangular lumbar pillows angled into the corners against the arms, raised on a slender blonde-oak base frame with square legs and a centre support.

assets.name: Posey Shelving Unit, Natural Oak
assets.description: Open bookcase in natural oak veneer with five stadium-shaped shelves with rounded ends, separated by staggered vertical panel dividers. Airy, curvy and gallery-like.

assets.name: Vincent Chair, Oak / Creamy White
assets.description: Light, slender dining chair in solid white oak with a curved plank backrest and an upholstered creamy-white seat pad. It matches the Vincent table.

assets.name: Vincent Dining Table 180cm, Oak
assets.description: Slim, light Scandinavian dining table in solid oak with a clear lacquer. A soft rounded-rectangle top sits on four gently splayed, tapered round legs.

assets.name: Wayne Armchair
assets.description: Retro Scandinavian lounge chair with a walnut-stained rubberwood frame whose curved back and arm rail is filled with vertical spindles. Loose oatmeal linen-blend seat and back cushions sit in it, and it stands on slim black steel legs.

assets.name: Generic 65in TV on stand
assets.description: Generic 65-inch flat-screen TV with a slim black bezel, standing on a small central pedestal foot in dark metal, for placing on a TV unit or media console.

assets.name: Cactus and succulent trio in light clay pots
assets.description: A tabletop trio of small desert plants in matching pale grey stone-effect clay pots set in a row: a round golden barrel cactus ribbed with yellow spines, a short upright columnar Mammillaria cactus, and a spiky zebra-striped Haworthia rosette.

product.variant: Composite: golden barrel cactus + Mammillaria + Haworthia (Suri), each in a light clay pot

assets.name: Fiddle-leaf fig tree 150–160cm in clay pot
assets.description: Fiddle-leaf fig (Ficus lyrata) grown as a small branching tree: a bare woody trunk splitting low into a few stems, carrying a tall loose column of very large glossy dark-green violin-shaped leaves from knee height to the top, in a wide tapered sand-coloured clay-washed pot.

product.variant: Fiddle-leaf fig 150–160cm (nursery 34cm) + Clay pot 38cm, Clay washed

assets.name: Kentia palm 160–180cm in rope basket
assets.description: Kentia palm (Howea forsteriana): several slender green canes rising from the pot, each carrying long arching feathery fronds of narrow drooping leaflets, forming a tall, airy, gently weeping crown, in a natural woven seagrass rope basket with dark vertical stitching.

assets.name: Monstera deliciosa 70–80cm in ribbed cream pot
assets.description: Swiss cheese plant (Monstera deliciosa): a wide bushy mound of large glossy dark-green heart-shaped leaves with deep splits and holes, held on long arching stems that spill outward, in a cream ceramic pot with fine vertical ribs.

product.variant: Swiss cheese plant 70–80cm (nursery 21cm) + Ceramic ribbed pot 24cm, Cream

assets.name: Olive tree standard 150–160cm in terracotta pot
assets.description: Olive tree (Olea europaea) trained as a lollipop standard: a slim straight grey-brown trunk about 1m tall topped by an airy round head of narrow silvery grey-green leaves, in a classic natural terracotta flowerpot with rolled rim on a matching saucer.

product.variant: Olive tree 150–160cm (nursery 27cm) + Terracotta pot with saucer 30cm, Natural

assets.name: Rubber plant 90–100cm in terracotta pot
assets.description: Rubber plant (Ficus elastica): several upright woody stems with large oval, thick, glossy deep-green leaves held outward at all levels, a bushy shrub shape, in a natural terracotta flowerpot on a saucer.

product.variant: Rubber plant 90–100cm (nursery 27cm) + Terracotta pot with saucer 30cm, Natural

assets.name: Satin pothos trailing plant in clay pot
assets.description: Satin pothos (Scindapsus pictus): a low mound of heart-shaped matte dark-green leaves splashed with silver, with long trailing vines that spill over the pot rim and drape down the front and sides — a shelf or sideboard trailer — in a sand-coloured clay-washed pot.

product.variant: Satin pothos 30–40cm (nursery 15cm) + Clay pot 16cm, Clay washed

assets.name: Snake plant 70–80cm in terracotta pot
assets.description: Snake plant (Sansevieria trifasciata 'Laurentii'): a dense clump of stiff, upright sword-shaped leaves with dark green banding and yellow edges, slightly fanning outward, in a natural terracotta flowerpot on a saucer.

product.variant: Snake plant (Sansevieria laurentii) 70–80cm (nursery 21cm) + Terracotta pot with saucer 25cm, Natural

assets.name: Strelitzia nicolai (bird of paradise) 160–170cm in terracotta egg pot
assets.description: Giant white bird of paradise (Strelitzia nicolai): a fan of long upright stems carrying huge paddle-shaped, banana-like leaves, some split along the veins, splaying outward in an open vase shape, in a rounded natural terracotta egg pot on a saucer.

product.variant: Strelitzia nicolai 160–170cm (nursery 27cm) + Terracotta egg pot with saucer 35cm, Natural

assets.name: String of hearts in hanging clay pot
assets.description: String of hearts (Ceropegia woodii) in a hanging planter: long fine purple-grey strands of small silver-marbled heart-shaped leaves cascading 30–40cm below a pale stone-grey clay pot, which hangs from tan leather straps gathered to a brass ring on a single cord from the ceiling.

product.variant: String of hearts 20–30cm (nursery 12cm) + Clay pot 16cm, Grey, Hanging

assets.name: ZZ plant 40–50cm in rope basket
assets.description: ZZ plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia): upright arching stems lined with pairs of small, glossy, waxy dark-green oval leaflets, like a loose bunch of feathers, in a natural woven seagrass rope basket with dark vertical stitching. Small enough for a sideboard or floor corner.

product.variant: ZZ plant & basket bundle: Zamioculcas 40–50cm (nursery 12cm) + Rope basket, Cream (15cm ext. width)

assets.name: Bauhaus Ausstellung 1923 poster, Joost Schmidt (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of the Staatliches Bauhaus Ausstellung poster, Joost Schmidt, 1923 (public domain). Yellow-ochre ground with a bold constructivist figure: a thick red ring at upper left, a black arch and upright band forming an S-curve down the centre, a black J-hook at lower right, red bars at middle right. BAUHAUS in black capitals across the top, STAATLICHES small in red up the left, AUSSTELLUNG in black along the lower left, WEIMAR at the bottom, 1923 vertical on the right. Slim matte black frame, narrow white mount.

product.variant: 50×70 cm portrait, black wood frame, narrow white mount

assets.name: Golden Dusk poster, Postery (framed)
assets.description: Framed colour-field poster 'Golden Dusk': a tall rectangle of smooth gradient from warm golden orange at the top to deep red-orange at the bottom, Rothko-like, on a cream border. Slim matte black wood frame, no mount.

product.variant: 30×40 cm portrait, Picture Frame Wood Black

assets.name: Bauhaus Ausstellung postcard, Wassily Kandinsky (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Kandinsky's postcard for the 1923 Bauhaus Ausstellung, Weimar (public domain). On cream paper, a large dark maroon disc at lower left crossed by a red arc, a black-and-white chequered flag beside it, a blue disc ringed in black near the top centre, and a fan of fine black lines and a ladder-like track radiating across the right half; BAU-HAUS- in black capitals at top left, AUSSTELLUNG and WEIMAR in black capitals down the left, JULI - SEPTEMBER 1923 along the bottom. Light oak frame with a white mount.

product.variant: 30×40 cm portrait, oak frame, white mount

assets.name: Composition VIII, Wassily Kandinsky (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Composition VIII, Wassily Kandinsky, 1923 (public domain). A landscape composition on a pale cream ground: a large black-ringed violet-and-black circle at upper left, a cluster of small red, blue and yellow circles, criss-crossing thin black lines, sharp triangles and semicircles, chequerboard strips and grids spread across the lower right — airy, precise geometric abstraction. Light natural oak frame with a wide white mount.

product.variant: 100×70 cm landscape, oak frame, white mount

assets.name: Several Circles, Wassily Kandinsky (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Several Circles, Wassily Kandinsky, 1926 (public domain). Translucent overlapping circles float on a deep blue-black ground: a large black disc ringed in blue with a glowing halo at upper left of centre, smaller circles in pink, violet, turquoise, yellow and red scattered around it. Matte black wood frame with a white passe-partout.

product.variant: 50×50 cm square, black wood frame, white passe-partout

assets.name: Castle and Sun, Paul Klee (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Castle and Sun (Burg und Sonne), Paul Klee, 1928 (public domain). A mosaic of small coloured rectangles, triangles and half-circles in warm reds, oranges, ochres, greens and dusky blue stacked like a castle town, with a round orange-red sun at upper left against a dark red-brown sky. Light oak frame with a white mount.

product.variant: 40×30 cm landscape, oak frame, white mount

assets.name: Construction A II, László Moholy-Nagy (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Construction A II, László Moholy-Nagy, 1924 (public domain). On a warm ochre-tan ground, overlapping translucent planes: a long black parallelogram band across the middle, a yellow diagonal bar, a red circle, pale grey and white transparent quadrilaterals layered over one another — crisp constructivist geometry. White wood frame with a white mount.

product.variant: 50×40 cm landscape, white wood frame, white mount

assets.name: Composition II in Red, Blue and Yellow, Piet Mondrian (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Composition II in Red, Blue and Yellow, Piet Mondrian, 1930 (public domain). A near-square grid of thick black lines on white: a large bright red square fills the upper right, a small blue square at lower left, a small yellow rectangle at lower right, white rectangles elsewhere. White wood frame with a white passe-partout.

product.variant: 50×50 cm square, white wood frame, white passe-partout

assets.name: Neutral Canvas poster, Postery (framed)
assets.description: Framed abstract poster 'Neutral Canvas': soft brushed blocks of pale grey, sand and warm white overlapping like a modernist collage, crossed by long thin graphite arcs and curves that sweep across their edges. Quiet, neutral, gallery-like. Slim light oak frame, no mount.

assets.name: Papiers Découpés Orange poster, Postery (framed)
assets.description: Framed mid-century cut-out poster 'Papiers Découpés Orange': a coral-orange seaweed-like leaf shape (Matisse-style paper cut-out) on a periwinkle-blue rectangle, set on a warm cream sheet with 'PAPIERS DÉCOUPÉS' in black capitals above and '1955' and 'GALERIE D'ART' in small black type below. Slim white wood frame, no mount.

product.variant: 70×100 cm portrait, Picture Frame Wood White

assets.name: Bauhaus Stairway, Oskar Schlemmer (framed)
assets.description: Framed print of Bauhaus Stairway (Bauhaustreppe), Oskar Schlemmer, 1932 (public domain). Stylised mannequin-like figures climb a pale blue-grey staircase towards tall gridded windows; a figure in a bright red-orange top in the centre, others in browns, white and black, smooth rounded heads, soft light — a calm, architectural composition. Matte black wood frame with a white mount.

product.variant: 70×100 cm portrait, black wood frame, white mount

layouts.name: Chaise lounge, bench by the wall
layouts.notes: Big-sofa scheme. Lounge: Auburn chaise sofa (left-facing, so the chaise points at the window) against the left wall, wall-mounted TV on the hall-side wall just before the hall door, Harper marble coffee table on an Inez rug, Mori C side table with a Faro table lamp at the sofa end, Faro floor lamp in the corner by the hall door. Dining: Vincent 1.8m table shifted towards the left wall with the Nico bench against that side and three Vincent chairs facing it from the hall side plus one at the beam end (seats 7), so the kitchen-to-hall route runs behind the chairs at 757mm+ (I202 accepted). W102 on the sofa is a known artefact: legroom is measured from the chaise tip, not the seats (per-section clearance zones are being added).

layouts.name: Chaise lounge, big table (decorated)
layouts.notes: Copy of Patrick's "Chaise lounge, big table" with every original item left exactly where it was, plus decoration: Blair pendant over the dining table, cactus trio on it, Faro table lamp on the side table, trailing pothos on top of the Harper hutch, olive tree on the hall-side wall between dining and TV, monstera in the corner under the mirror, string of hearts hanging by the window; prints: Kandinsky Several Circles (hall-side wall), Mondrian (right of the kitchen door), Klee Castle and Sun (above the side table). The remaining warnings (chaise vs coffee table legroom, radiator, window) are from the original layout and were left as they are.

finishes.walls: deep earthy terracotta red-brown, chalky matt (like Farrow & Ball Red Earth) - walls only

layouts.name: Dining + window lounge
layouts.notes: Broken-plan: 6-seat dining under pendant L1 at the kitchen end; lounge at the bright window end with the sofa on the long west wall facing a wall-mounted TV on the east wall (tucked below the hall door). Middle kept open as circulation. Scandinavian/warm per the room brief.

layouts.name: Hall-side sofa, round table
layouts.notes: Mirror-image scheme. Owen II sofa against the hall-side wall facing a wall-mounted TV on the left wall, Harper marble coffee table on the caramel Cora rug - the kitchen-to-hall route runs down the TV side (877mm past the coffee table) and turns into the hall door below the sofa. Dining: Harper round 120 table with four walnut Austen chairs set on the diagonals, which is what makes a round table for four fit a 2.98m room (I202: 746mm between the top-left chair and the kitchen wall - accepted). Window end: Harper curved sideboard with the Faro mirror above on the left wall, Arlo armchair and Faro lamp. Sockets S1/S4 end up behind the sideboard and sofa (I201, plug in first).

layouts.name: Kitchen-end dining, art & plants
layouts.notes: Candidate A dressed with art and plants: Kandinsky Composition VIII over the sofa, Joost Schmidt 1923 Bauhaus poster over the bench, Mondrian Composition II by the dining chairs; bird of paradise in the corner left of the kitchen door (the corner right of the door pinched the route to 366mm), olive tree by the hall door, pothos on the Posey shelving, cactus trio on the table, string of hearts hanging by the window. Mirror moved to the right of the kitchen door. Lint clean apart from infos (S1 behind shelving; 715mm route past the bench).

layouts.name: Kitchen-end dining, wall TV
layouts.notes: Dining at the kitchen end: Harper 1.8m table along the room with two Anya chairs on the pier side, one at the beam end and a Nico bench on the hall side tucked under the table, so the kitchen-door to hall-door route keeps 715mm past the bench (I202 accepted: a bench tucks in, chairs would not). Blair pendant centred over the table. Lounge in the front half: Auburn 3-seater against the left wall facing a wall-mounted 65in TV on the hall-side wall (no TV unit, which would cut the route below 700mm). Mori coffee table on an Inez rug. Window end is a reading corner: Avery swivel chair angled to the TV, Faro lamp, Posey shelving on the left wall (hides socket S1 - plug in first). Seats 6 at the table (bench takes 2-3).

layouts.name: Starter
layouts.notes: Seeded example: sofa against the long left wall (W6), coffee table in front of it, rug under the table.
